title: duplicate-run
setup: Create a fresh short Unix socket path and an empty lifetime-lock directory in test-owned temporary storage; set L_PHASE1_SOCKET and L_PHASE1_DIRECTORY for the orchestrator. Start the controller before the program.
Each child has its own connection. Parse a complete ready <label> <pid> line and reject duplicate/unexpected labels. Record direct PIDs separately from controller and orchestrator.
Controller commands are exactly release followed by LF; readiness does not release a child. Test deadlines bound failures only.

Keep every controller connection open until runtime shutdown has been observed. Require spontaneous child disconnection and lifetime-lock release before controller closure or fallback signals; record cleanup failures before fallback. Lock release alone does not prove direct-child reaping.
assertions: At most one child launch. Second Run preserves first invocation and fatal cleanup terminates it.
